title: ui skill router: name action refusals on the Actions row
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbWDsbbJizuYnDwBxT8

Follow-up of #34824 (PR #35087), from L1-b's nit 1 (comment 6976263388 on #35087) and the #34824 dev report's out-of-scope note. #35087 teaches the action `refusals` declaration in `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md`, but the router in `skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md` (the task table row "A button or operation: `locations`, visibility, dialog and toast copy, params, new tab, the body's `ctx`" → [Actions](./rules/actions.md)) does not name refusals, so a model looking for "a refused action's message" is not sent to that rule. The router row was card #34770's file and #35077 merged without it, so this finding has no other carrier.

## Done when

- The Actions router row names `refusals` (the declared refusal codes and their messages) in the same few words as the rule file's heading.
- `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`: the `skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md` row is paid in the same file first (ruling record 6513306068, letter B); regenerate whatever the skill generators derive.
- Text-only change to served skill text: `Clause-②: no` (seat ruling kept by seat 1).

## Order

Tier H (`skills/**`). After #35087 merges (it owns `rules/actions.md`'s heading).
